chapters.title: DFS with an original → copy map

frames.caption: DFS with an original → copy map — O(V + E) time, O(V) extra space. Input: clone_graph(node=list (1)). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
return clone(node) if node else None — calls clone(n=(1))
c = copies[n] = Node(n.val) — copies[(2)] = (2); c moves to (2) (record before recursing)
c = copies[n] = Node(n.val) — copies[(3)] = (3); c moves to (3) (record before recursing)
c = copies[n] = Node(n.val) — copies[(4)] = (4); c moves to (4) (record before recursing)
c.neighbors = [clone(nb) for nb in n.neighbors] — n moves to (4); nb moves to (4)
c.neighbors = [clone(nb) for nb in n.neighbors] — n moves to (3); c moves to (3); nb moves to (3)
c.neighbors = [clone(nb) for nb in n.neighbors] — n moves to (2); c moves to (2); nb moves to (2)
c.neighbors = [clone(nb) for nb in n.neighbors] — n moves to (1)

frames.caption: BFS with an original → copy map — O(V + E) time, O(V) extra space. Input: clone_graph(node=list (1)). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
n = queue.popleft() — (1) taken from the front of queue
n = queue.popleft() — (2) taken from the front of queue; n moves to (2)
n = queue.popleft() — (4) taken from the front of queue; n moves to (4)
n = queue.popleft() — (3) taken from the front of queue; n moves to (3)
